extraction_issues.impact: Exact SD values and every plotted dose bar are not available as text/XML tables; final records keep prose-supported exact values and database-linked rows, and do not fabricate graph-derived values.
The only supplementary archive contains COI/transparency PDFs, not assay spreadsheets or activity tables; no activity value is missing from a local supplement.

extraction_scope: Worker-2 source-reviewed cytotoxicity repair from primary XML/PDF prose, figure captions/images, and linked DBAASP assay rows; no graph-derived values were invented.

source_review_notes.figure_policy: Figure-only non-tabulated bars and SD magnitudes are retained as cautionary extraction limits, not fabricated row values.
source_review_notes.supplement_policy: OA mmc1.zip was opened by listing and contains only transparency/COI disclosure PDFs.
source_review_notes.supported_value_policy: Rows capture values explicitly stated in primary results prose or linked database rows matched to primary prose/figure locators.
